_: Official NeoSkript addons: made and maintained by Xena Studios, released and tested with NeoSkript. Shown on /addons/. Each entry: name, summary (one sentence), adds (what syntax it gives scripts), example (a few lines of script), version, status (beta or stable), and links (modrinth, source, docs; any can be left out).

official.name: NeoSkriptWeb
official.summary: HTTP requests, webhooks and JSON for scripts, without blocking the server. Scripts written for Reqn, or for skJson's requests and JSON, run unchanged.
official.adds: Requests that wait for their answer without blocking the server, JSON from text and the web, and JSON into list variables and back.
